model.name: Gate invocation integrity — a spawned gate returns the tool's real result; a broken invocation marks-not-silences (counted, never removed)
model.description: A ci:gate that RUNS but returns NULL on its SPAWNED-tool invocation is a broken PROVER masquerading as a result — the gate's null could read as pass or as fail, neither true. MEASURED (expert): 2 revived gates run-but-null on spawn while the tool is GREEN STANDALONE (r241-objectverb: scoreboard=null but tool standalone=537 reqs GREEN; r245-s24: T24.4 gen-md=null, T24.5 audit.strict=false). Root = STALE subprocess cwd / output-parse in the gate SPAWN (NOT a repoint regression: siblings r217/r218/r218b GREEN; NOT the tools). FIX the spawn invocation so a spawned gate returns the tool's REAL result. INTERIM (mark-not-silence, R37.25 doctrine): a gate whose invocation is known-broken STAYS + RUNS + carries a KNOWN-BROKEN-INVOCATION marker naming this task (status EXPLAINED not hidden), NEVER removed/disabled (= the check:task-status silent-deletion mistake); the marker set is COUNTED + can-only-shrink.

discoverySource.evidence: r241-objectverb scoreboard=null vs standalone 537 GREEN; r245-s24 T24.4 gen-md=null / T24.5 audit.strict=false; siblings r217/r218/r218b GREEN => spawn not repoint not tools

model.crossRefNote: Gate-integrity family sibling: R37.17 (gates not a product-shape SNAPSHOT) + R37.18 (a gate resolves an artifact the SAME WAY runtime does) — this adds INVOCATION-mechanics integrity (the spawn faithfully returns the tool's result), a DISTINCT property. The mark-not-silence + counted-can-only-shrink interim IS R37.25's coverage-self-report + named-debt doctrine (never delete a gate to go green = the check:task-status mistake). The 'null while standalone-GREEN' diagnosis is R37.25 Arm-B positive-control (validate a result against the instrument's proven ability to succeed). Rides R40.54 failable.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Fix the gate SPAWN so a spawned-tool invocation returns the tool's REAL result — resolve the stale subprocess cwd + the output-parse that produced NULL. After the fix, r241-objectverb returns the real scoreboard (~537 reqs) and r245-s24 returns real T24.4/T24.5 results, matching standalone.

gateRef.assertion: a spawned gate's result == the tool's standalone result (no null-from-stale-cwd/parse)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a gate spawn with a stale cwd/parse => null; after fix => real result matching standalone

acceptanceCriteria.text: INTERIM: a gate with a known-broken invocation STAYS in ci:gates and RUNS, carrying a KNOWN-BROKEN-INVOCATION marker that NAMES this task (status EXPLAINED, not hidden). It is NEVER removed or disabled — removing/disabling a gate to make the suite green is the check:task-status silent-deletion mistake (a deleted gate certifies nothing + hides the hole).

gateRef.assertion: a gate with a broken invocation carries a KNOWN-BROKEN marker naming its task; a removed/disabled gate (to dodge the failure) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a gate removed/disabled to hide a broken invocation => RED; marked-known-broken + still-runs => admissible

acceptanceCriteria.text: The suite EMITS 'N gates / M known-broken (listed by name)' every run, and the M set can ONLY SHRINK (a known-broken marker is removed only by FIXING the gate, never by hiding it). A marker set that grows silently, or a known-broken gate absent from the emitted list, => RED (else the marker becomes a quiet dumping ground = decay). Same shape as R37.25 AC-coverage-self-report.

gateRef.assertion: every run emits N-gates/M-known-broken-by-name; a known-broken gate missing from the list OR the M-set grown-without-fix => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a known-broken gate absent from the emitted M list => RED; M grown by hiding (not fixing) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The diagnosis is EVIDENCED, not assumed: the tools are GREEN STANDALONE (positive control = the instrument CAN succeed) AND the repoint siblings (r217/r218/r218b) are GREEN => the suspect is the SPAWN invocation, NOT the tools and NOT a repoint regression. A gate's NULL is validated against the tool's standalone result before it is trusted as pass-or-fail (R37.25 Arm-B: a result asserted from a broken instrument is inadmissible).

gateRef.assertion: a gate null/result is checked against the tool's standalone result; null-while-standalone-GREEN => classified broken-invocation, not a real fail

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING (scenario-first #126): seed a gate null while the tool is GREEN standalone => classified KNOWN-BROKEN-INVOCATION (not a real fail, not a silent pass)
